entities.summary: Dwight "Bo" Lamar was an American professional basketball player. Born and raised in Columbus, Ohio, he was a two-time consensus All-American at University of Southwestern Louisiana, where he led the NCAA in scoring for the 1971-72 season. Lamar was the No. 1 overall pick in the 1973 American Basketball Association Draft.
